doc: world/lease-ui.md is canonical for behavior + copy. This file is the machine-readable mirror: lease lifecycle state machine, rent-run calendar, notice ladder, deposit/deduction rules, dispute schema, progression gates, and feed wording. Registry numbers (rents, tenants, units) live in jobs-housing.md §3 — this file governs how leases MOVE. All money is game dollars except credit-denominated fees marked cr (monetization §2.4/§2.8 PROPOSAL — do not contradict).

power_map.requests_pipeline: admin-domain deny — lease/rent/eviction asks are unreachable by request (moderation.json v8)
power_map.currency_wall: credits never pay rent/deposits/fees — game dollars only

states.note: unit on the board (housing.json listings_live + ladder)
application in; screening conditions evaluated (income ~2.5x, references, roommate interview)
lease offered; signing is atomic: lease row + first month + deposit + move-in record + listing off board + feed event
unpaid at day 10; formal notice issued
balance cleared at any rung; back to active, arrears history retained as a file scar
board filing open; notice ladder AND any posted raise FROZEN at current rung
admin queue card — never automatic; ledger + notices + disputes + household facts on the card
tenancy ended by admin; feed 'admin' event, neutral wording
tenant notice (30d), lease-end, OR no-fault notice (60d, mandatory relocation credit); deposit return itemized
unit between tenants; flips back to listed
deed recorded; rent line replaced by tax/HOA

lease_terms.then: month-to-month — no renewal paperwork, no rent bump for staying
lease_terms.rule: term stated on every lease file; ending a fixed term early is the tenant's break-fee conversation, month-to-month ends on 30-day notice
lease_terms.break_fee: notice inside the fixed term posts an itemized break fee — one month's rent, a ledger line deducted at deposit return; month-to-month ends on plain 30-day notice
lease_terms.demo_field: term — one line per lease row; breakFee flag + depPending/depDue on the lease

late_fee.note: house rule stated in every lease

rent_run.frozen_while: disputed (any rung) — no eviction while a board ruling is open

rent_control.raise_rule: every raise posts with a stated basis; the claim is what a dispute examines

annual_band.note: house rule, unbanked — use it or lose it; ledger line + dated notice

passthrough_claim.note: itemized math required in ledger; the claim is what a dispute examines

rent_control.raise_storage: posted raise stores rent_next; the 1st bills the new number; a filed dispute before the 1st sets rent_frozen — old rent bills until ruling/mediation withdraws or amends it

payment_plans.binding: nothing pauses until accepted — a proposal is an offer, not a shield
payment_plans.effect: honored plan pauses late-fee accrual and holds the ladder at plan_rung; balance still owes
payment_plans.installments: dated ledger lines; each due-day is checked — paid flag or breach
payment_plans.breach: missed installment resumes the ladder at plan_rung (never reset to day 6); breach is itself a ledger line
payment_plans.visibility: private mail — never a feed event
payment_plans.doc: the plan is a ledger document: proposed, dated, itemized installments

published_conditions: income ~2.5x rent (verified vs job board wages)
roommate interview where the unit shares a wall
screening.rule: first qualified application approves — no auctions, no vibe denials, no holding a listing to shop applicants
screening.decline_visibility: private mail naming the failed criterion; no feed event
sign_atomic: first month + deposit leave the bank
screening.proration: signing after the 1st prorates the first month — round(rent × days-remaining / 30); the deposit stays 1× rent; the prorated line is itemized on the ledger

move_in_record.contents: itemized condition lines; anything marked pre-existing is the baseline
move_in_record.gate: a deposit deduction naming a pre-existing item is refused outright — the record settles it, not an argument
move_in_record.demo_field: movein — array of condition lines per lease

notices.name: eviction_filing
notices.trigger: window expired, no cure, no open dispute

notices.name: no_fault_notice
notices.note: admin-only; mandatory relocation credit; distinct NOFAULT ledger code

deposits.interest: simple ~1%/yr texture line — registry tracks principal, ledger computes at return
deposits.return_clock: move-out starts the clock — depPending + depDue (move-out day + 21); the return posts as a separate itemized event by admin or the unit's licensed landlord; an overdue return writes a 'deposit return overdue' ledger line (board-able grounds) and the lateness stays on the file
deduction_whitelist: damage beyond ordinary wear (named per item)
cleaning to move-in condition (only if returned worse)
deposits.move_in_gate: deductions are checked against the move-in record; a pre-existing item is refused, not argued
deposits.return_rule: minus itemized deductions only — every deduction is a ledger line with a reason
deposits.informal_occupants: room shares (c2-jules, c3-dani) are person-to-person — never ledger objects

habitability.sla: acknowledged same-day, scheduled ~2 days, target fix <= 7 days
habitability.breach: open past the target writes an SLA-breach ledger line — legal weight that strengthens a dispute; the breach stays on the file after the fix

routine.sla: acknowledged ~3 days, scheduled ~7, done ~14; every status change is a dated ledger object

repairs.dispute_weight: open habitability item strengthens a dispute; rulings may order repair + rent credit

amendments.roommate_swap: co-tenant add/remove is a lease-amendment doc + deposit pro-rata ledger line; the incoming name is screened like any applicant; the remaining tenant's file keeps continuity; joint liability, one balance — the ledger doesn't adjudicate splits
amendments.decline: a declined amendment names the reason on the file; a new amendment can be filed

disputes.raise_freeze: a filing with rent_next pending sets rent_frozen — old rent bills on the 1st until ruling or a signed offer

mediation.offer: either side states a concrete ledger-shaped proposal during mediation_week; documented on the file
mediation.accept: amends the ledger directly (new rent line, repair scheduled, filing withdrawn → active); posts the same neutral 'rent-board ruling' feed line — a deal reads like a decision
mediation.decline: costs the week it took; ruling clock resumes; either side can walk
mediation.never: dialogue scripts — offers are proposals, not performed conversations

disputes.evidence: ledger objects only — repair requests, payment lines, claimed passthrough math, the move-in record; no testimony mechanics
disputes.feed: rulings are housing events, neutral wording; amounts stay in the file
disputes.live_example: bld-g9457-3 (c4-priya+c5-marcus): raise 2600->3200 contested on passthrough claim + dead heater; keep ambiguous, never resolve in content

sublets.request: tenant files: named subtenant, stated dates, rent at or under lease rate
sublets.rule: approval not unreasonably withheld — a decline needs a stated reason on the file
sublets.board: a live sublet posts a listing-shaped entry marked (sublet); tenant of record stays liable
sublets.informal: informal room shares stay person-to-person and off-ledger — unchanged

eviction.hired_characters: not exempt — miss rent and the admin may evict (design §6)
eviction.feed_wording: admin action — tenancy ended at <address>; never the debt amount, never the reason text

file_scars.rule: cured arrears stay on the file (hist) — visible to the tenant and to landlords of that unit; never a feed event, never a denial criterion on its own

owner.rule: offer at asking, first accepted wins — no bidding

feed_wording.listing_filled: Listing filled — <address> comes off the board
feed_wording.turnover: Unit turning over — <address> back on the board

demo_seed.note: lease.html demo state — mirrors jobs-housing §3; money in game $
demo_seed.viewer_character: h01 (demo hired character, tenant of bld-g9457-2)
demo_seed.licensed_landlord: h02 (demo; owns bld-f9088-5, studio rented to an ambient tenant, balance outstanding day 1)
demo_seed.day: day 6 of the month — h01's rent is in grace-lapsed; 9457-3 dispute is open with its raise frozen
demo_seed.v54_surfaces: prorated first month on mid-month signing; break fee inside a fixed term; repair clock (habitability ≤7-day SLA + breach line); roommate amendments; 21-day deposit clock with overdue line
